_documentation: Hand-maintained identity for comparative study flights. firmware_file is relative to the crazyswarm2 crazyflie/ directory or absolute; if the file exists on this machine its sha256 is compared with firmware_sha256 (mismatch refuses takeoff), otherwise it is recorded as unverified (the hash of the flashed image cannot be read from the drone). Fill cf_second and UPDATE cf5 firmware_sha256 to the image actually flashed (candidate with the 96-variable uSD cap: cf21bl_study_usd96_rnn_iz_sentinel_ON.bin, sha256 14575bacacccc8e50fbcab0d01aa789adaae4966033bf7397b3cff167db4be3c — built 2026-10-11, not flashed) at the shakedown flash. 2026-10-15: both drones flashed with study_tree_v1.bin (Omar C tree + NS2 in C, flash weights ns2_v1); previous image cf21bl_study_usd96_rpmf_rnn_iz_sentinel_ON_tk.bin sha256 cb38f3f4981d8fa6b9c85c9e26d5645b5535040328d4ef99926a1c267037f8ca.
